title: Lawmaker laments 'gap' in GMRC teachers after school incidents
summary: The chairperson of the House Committee on Basic Education on Monday lamented what he called a 'big gap' in the teaching of Good Manners and Right Conduct (GMRC) following 'incidents' in schools.
